trades.name: Failed reclaim of 6273.75-6276.5
trades.quote: Therefore, shorts on a failed reclaim of 6273.75-6276.5 are fine. Monitor for continuation through 6264-6266.
trades.stop_hint: If they continue to aggressively buy dips below 6261.5 (and reclaim 64-66) then they can get retests of 6273.75-6276.5 and potentially 6282.5-6284.

trades.name: Failure to reclaim 6282.5-6284
trades.quote: Shorting a failure to reclaim 6282.5-6284 is fine as well as it is a better reward, though perhaps lower probability as it would need to get back through both 73.75-76.5 and 64-66.

trades.name: Short at 6292-6293 / weekly 6293-6296
trades.quote: Above 82.5-84 should see 92/93 (the weekly 93-96 spot) and we could see stronger sellers show up there. I would be a bit hesitant to short it directly as so many shorts from today would be offsides, but I am open to a short here at least for a rotation to 82.5-84

trades.name: Session downtrend / lower high below 6264-6266
trades.quote: I’m cautious trying to be short below 64-66 but am willing to join a session downtrend on a lower high below there, targeting the completed rotation to 6230s.

trades.name: Higher low above 6264-6266
trades.quote: There isn’t a whole lot of room to work with between 64-66 and 73.75-76.5 but a higher low above 66 has potential for 82.5-84 so I would consider it and remain cautious on a 73.75-76.5 test.

trades.name: LBAF of today's low (or lower open + upside reversal)
trades.quote: If we get a LBAF of today’s low or open lower tonight but see an upside reversal, I think it is fine joining the long side an evaluating a 64-66 test (likely taking profit and ensuring stops are in place in case it rejects).

trades.name: Higher low holding 6282.5-6284 after reclaim
trades.quote: Back above 6282.5-6284 should see at least 6292-6293. I’m not a huge fan of reclaim longs but if you can find an entry on a higher low holding 82.5-84 it should find 92-93 at least with potential for today’s high as so many sellers would be trapped lower.

trades.name: LBAF of 6233-6235.5
trades.quote: Another LBAF of 6233-6235.5 has potential for 64-66 and 73.75-76.5 so I am okay with this long. I would be cautious of a rejection at today’s low which is last week’s VPOC.

trades.name: LBAF of last week's low (6224.25)
trades.quote: I still think we need to monitor for a LBAF of last week’s low 6224.25). We never tagged the 6/27 5pm close 6220.75. If a LBAF of last week’s low reclaims 6233-6235.5 then it can turn into the above setup.
